tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dmag zlog nyi shu rtsa lnga las: mgon po bdun cu rtsa gnyis mdos kyi bca' thabs bskul pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈ mgon po bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi mdos bca' thabs la:
ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i bum pa'i rtse mo la
nam mkha' dmar ser mda' ser ltong sngon rgyang bu sna tshogs cod pan gzugs: bang rim dang po'i
1$0000220 phyogs skyong bcu la/1$0000300

shar phyogs nam mkha' rgyang bu dkar po bya'o: shar lhor nam mkha' dmar skya: mda' rgyang thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra'o: lhor smug nag: lho nub tu sngo skya: nub stod du dkar po: nub smad du ser po: nub byang du dud kha: byang du ser po: byang shar du dkar skya: shar stod du ser nag: shar smad du dkar po rnams btsug: bang rim gnyis pa la:
1$0000220 rgyal chen bzhi la/1$0000300
shar dkar: lho sngo: nub dmar: byang ljang gu'o:

shar stod du dmar po: shar smad du mthing ga: lho stod du ljang gu: lho smad du dmar po: nub stod du dkar po: nub smad du dmar po: byang stod du smug po: byang smad du ser nag gzug go: bang rim gsum pa
shar ser po: shar lho dmar po: lhor sngon po: lho nub tu dmar po: nub ser po: nub byang du ljang gu: byang dang byang shar du dkar po re gzug go: bang rim bzhi pa la
shar du dkar po: lho ru sngon po: nub tu dkar po: byang du ser po: shar lhor dmar po: lho nub tu dud kha: nub byang du nag po: byang shar du dmar po gzug: bang rim 'og gi gdan la
1$0000220rgyu skar nyer brgyad la/1$0000300
shar du dkar po bdun: lho ru sngon po bdun: nub tu dmar po bdun: byang du ljang gu bdun:
1$0000220gnod sbyin lnga la/1$0000300

yang shar du ser: lhor dkar: nub tu nag: byang stod du dmar: byang smad du khong ljang 'ja' ris can rnams gzug go: lcags ri la nam mkha': mda': rgyang bu: shing ris sna tshogs: gling bcu gnyis la'ang phyogs mdog gi nam rgyang mda' 'phang shing ris sogs dang: gzhan yang gri: mdung: pho tang: mo tang: 'phan rgyal mtshan sogs bkod: 'bru gsog ni bskul ba las shes par bya'o: bskul gyi man ngag ni gtor ma dang mdos gnyis su shes par bya'o: mjug la
1$0000270bka'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la:1$0000300 bka' yi mdos chen 'di bzhes la:

zhes shes par bya'o: ri rab kyi man ngag ni: gdan gnyis brtsegs bang rim bum pa bre dang ldan pa shar dkar: lhor sngo: nub dmar: byang ljang gu bya: rtsibs dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa yang bskul ba bzhin du bris la 'god par bya'o:

1$0000230de nas mdos byin gyis brlab pa spyi ltar byas la: bdag dpal phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin du zhugs la 'di skad do: 1$0000300hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten na: tshangs rigs lha yi gzhal yas na: tshangs pa chen po'i thugs dam bskul: sku mdog dmar ser 'bar ba la: gser gyi me tog mdzes pas brgyan: chibs su cang shes ngang pa 'chib: gser gyi 'khor lo phyag na bsnams: sangs rgyas stong gis dbang bskur pas: khyed kyi rdzu 'phrul de yis ni: khros na srid pa gsum yang 'jig: 'jig rten mes po mthu bo che: sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dgongs la: gshegs shig 'gro ba'i don la gshegs: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: las ngan 'dul ba'i dus la babs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ brah+ma ya sarba duṣ+ṭān sarba big+nān hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: phyogs skyong bcu yi dus la babs: shar phyogs dbang po brgya byin ni: sku mdog dkar po glang chen zhon: rdo rje gdeng pa phyag na bsnams: lha yi gdon rigs dbang du sdus: shar lho me lha chen po ni: dmar skya ra skyes chibs su 'chib: hom gzar 'bar ba'i me 'od kyis: drang srong gdon rigs dbang du sdus: lho phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po ni: sku mdog smug nag ma he zhon: phyag mtshan 'jigs pa'i be con gyis:

gshin rje'i gdon rigs dbang du sdus: lho nub bden bral rgyal po ni: sku mdog sngo skya ro langs zhon: phyag mtshan ral gri 'bar ba bsnams: srin po'i gdon rigs dbang du sdus: nub phyogs chu bdag rgyal po ni: sku mdog dkar po chu srin zhon: phyag mtshan bdug pa sbrul zhags 'phen: klu yi gdon rigs dbang du sdus: nub byang rlung lha'i rgyal po ni: sku mdog dud kha ri dwags zhon: rlung gi ba dan phyag na bsnams: rig 'dzin gdon rigs dbang du sdus: byang phyogs gnod sbyin rgyal po ni: gser mdog rdzu 'phrul rta la zhon: phyag na rin chen dbyug to yis: gnod sbyin gdon rigs dbang du sdus: byang shar dbang ldan rgyal po ni: thal ba'i mdog can khyu mchog zhon: rtse gsum 'bar ba phyag na bsnams: 'byung po'i gdon rigs dbang du sdus: steng gi phyogs nas bgegs 'dul ba: nyi zla khros pa mthu bo che: shugs can rta bdun shing rta bcibs: nyi zla'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams: bar snang bgegs rigs dbang du sdus: 'og gi phyogs nas bgegs 'dul ba: sa bdag khros pa phag la bcibs: phyag na bcud kyi bum pa 'dzin: 'og gi bgegs rigs dbang du sdus: ston pa'i bka' nyan phyogs skyong bcu: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ in+d+ra ya: ag+ne ya: ya mā ya:

nai ri ta ya: ba ru ṇā ya: bā ya be: ku bai rā ya: ī sha nā ya: sur+ya tsan+d+ra ye: pa ti bhū mi: sarba duṣ+ṭān sarba bīg naṃ hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: rgyal chen bzhi yi dus la babs: ri rab lhun po'i shar phyogs nas: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung: sku mdog dkar po bse khrab gsol: gser gyi rmog zhu gyen du 'bar: phyag na sgra snyan rgyud mangs bsnams: lha chen khros pa mthu bo che: dri za 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor: thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: ri rab lhun po'i lho phyogs nas: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: sku mdog sngon po bse khrab gsol: gser gyi rmog zhu 'od du 'bar: phyag na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams: gshin rje khros pa mthu bo che: grul bum 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor: thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: ri rab lhun po'i nub phyogs nas: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang: sku mdog dmar po bse khrab gsol: gser gyi rmog zhu 'od du 'bar: phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams: klu bdud khros pa mthu bo che: gdug pa 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor:

thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sku mdog ljang gu bse khrab gsol: gser gyi rmog zhu 'od du 'bar: phyag na rin chen be con bsnams: gnod sbyin khros pa mthu bo che: las byed 'bum gyi dmag dang bcas: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor: thu ba brdzes la phrag pa phud: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'jig rten skyong ba khyod bzhi yang: sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan dgongs la: sangs rgyas bstan la dgra byung gis: chos shig chos skyong dgra la chos: oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: bi rū ḍha kā ya swā hā: bi rū pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭān sarba bīg naṃ hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: lha chen brgyad kyi dus la babs: lha chen dbang phyug chen po ni: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: chibs su seng ge dkar mo 'chib: phyag na tri shul 'bar ba bsnams: lha chen rgyal po khyab 'jug ni: sku mdog mthing ka 'od zer 'bar: chibs su gser sbrul ser po 'chib: phyag na 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams: lha chen bh+ring gi ri ti ni: sku mdog ljang ku 'od zer 'bar: chibs su rdzu 'phrul rta la 'chib: phyag na pi wang sgra snyan bsnams:

lha chen dga' byed dbang phyug ni: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: chibs su khyu mchog glang po 'chib: phyag na mda' gzhu 'bar ba bsnams: lha chen gzhon nu karti ka: sku mdog dkar po 'od zer 'bar: chibs su bya gag dkar po 'chib: phyag na mdzes pa'i bum pa bsnams: lha chen tshogs bdag chen po ni: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: chibs su byi ba sngon po 'chib: phyag na 'bar ba'i dbyug to bsnams: lha chen legs ldan nag po ni: sku mdog smug nag 'od zer 'bar: chibs su ro langs 'jigs pa 'chib: phyag na tsan dan beng chen bsnams: lha chen stobs bzang gzhon nu ni: sku mdog ser nag 'od zer 'bar: chibs su glang chen rab brtan 'chib: phyag na rin chen 'bar ba bsnams: lha chen brgyad po khyed rnams kyang*/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ru i a bh+rika hūm̐/ sarba duṣ+ṭān sarba bīg naṃ hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: klu chen brgyad kyi dus la babs: klu chen rgyal po mtha' yas ni: sku mdog ser po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na rin chen 'bar ba bsnams: klu chen rgyal po 'jog po ni: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na me tog ut+pal bsnams: klu chen rgyal po stobs kyis rgyu: sku mdog sngon po 'od zer 'bar:

phyag na sprin gyi phung po bsnams: klu chen rgyal po stobs ldan ni: sku mdog dmar po ral pa can: phyag na rin chen sdong po bsnams: klu chen rgyal po nor rgyas ni: sku mdog ser po ral pa can: phyag na rin chen phreng ba bsnams: klu chen rgyal po dung skyong ni: sku mdog ljang khu ral pa can: phyag na 'bud dung sgra sgrog bsnams: klu chen rgyal po pad+ma ni: sku mdog dkar po ral pa can: phyag na pad+ma dkar po bsnams: klu chen rgyal po pad chen ni: sku mdog dkar po ral pa can: phyag na sbrul zhags dkar po bsnams: gdug pa'i rgyal po khyed rnams kyang: sku stod mi la sku smad sbrul: mgo lus rin chen 'bar bas brgyan: mthong reg kha rlangs sbrul lce 'jigs: gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: dbang du sdus la rdul du rlogs: oṃ a nan ta: tak+ṣa ka: karko ṭa: bha la sa ta: ba su kī: shaṃ kha pā la: pad+ma: ma hā pad+ma: sarba duṣ+ṭān sarba bīg naṃ hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: gza' chen brgyad kyi dus la babs: shar phyogs gza' chen pa wa sangs: sku mdog dkar po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na pad+ma dkar po bsnams: lho phyogs gza' chen phur bu ni: sku mdog sngon po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na glegs bam po ti bsnams: nub phyogs gza' chen zla ba ni: sku mdog dkar po 'od zer 'bar:

phyag na me tog kun da bsnams: byang gi gza' chen lag pa ni: sku mdog ser po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na me tog ut+pal bsnams: shar lho mtshams kyi mig dmar ni: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: phyag na me tog dmar po bsnams: lho nub mtshams kyi sgra gcan ni: sku mdog dud kha 'od zer 'bar: phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: nub byang mtshams kyi spen pa ni: sku mdog nag la 'od zer 'bar: phyag na be con 'bar ba bsnams: byang shar mtshams kyi nyi ma ni: sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar: phyag na gcod pa'i 'khor lo bsnams: shin tu gtum po khyed rnams kyang: chibs su dus kyi rlung la 'chib: 'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyug: 'jig rten du ni zas 'phel byed: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: khyod kyis dus kyi khram la thobs: oṃ shu kra ye: shre ka: so ma: nu tra ya: ta ra ni: a bhi ta ye: da ri na su ta: gra ha pa ra ye swā hā: a ti ta ye: sarba sha truṃ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sarba big+nān hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: rgyu skar rnams kyi dus la babs: shar gyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: lha yi rgyu skar chen po bdun: smin drug mdog dkar snyan cha bsnams: bum pa bsnol ba'i khri la bzhugs: snar ma mdog dkar snyan cha bsnams: khyu mchog glang chen chibs su 'chib: mgo ni mdog dkar gdub bu bsnams: chibs su sha pho ru bcu 'chib:

lag ni mdog dkar dpung rgyan bsnams: mgo bdun sbrul gyi khri la bzhugs: nabs so mdog dkar rgyal mtshan bsnams: pad+ma dag gi gdan la bzhugs: rgyal ni dkar po nor bu bsnams: bum pa'i gdan gyi khri la bzhugs: skag ni dkar po ba dan bsnams: bya rog dag gi khri la bzhugs: lho yi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: gshin rje'i rgyu skar chen po bdun: mchu ni mdog sngo nyi ma bsnams: gser gyi khri la yang dag bzhugs: gre ni sngo dmar pad+ma 'dzin: pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs: sbo ni ljang gu rnga yab 'dzin: lha rdzas dar gyi gdan la bzhugs: me bzhi sngon po mu khyud thogs: glang chen khri la 'gying bar bzhugs: nag pa sngon po rin chen bsnams: rma bya mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: sa ri sngon po rin chen bsnams: chibs su rin chen shing rta 'chib: sa ga sngon po rin chen bsnams: rta mchog dkar po'i khri la bzhugs: nub kyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: klu yi rgyu skar chen po bdun: lha mtshams dmar po pad+ma bsnams: bya nag khri la yang dag bzhugs: snron ni mdog dmar pad+ma bsnams: 'bol gdan khri la yang dag bzhugs: snubs ni dmar po pad+ma bsnams: rus sbal 'jigs pa'i gdan la bzhugs: chu stod mdog dmar pad+ma bsnams: phub kyi gdan gyi steng na bzhugs: chu smad mdog dmar pad+ma bsnams: kur ma yi ni khri la bzhugs: gro bzhin dmar ser chu skyes 'dzin:

gser gyi khri la yang dag bzhugs: byi bzhin dmar ljang dpal be'u bsnams: glang chen ser po'i khri la bzhugs: byang gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: gnod sbyin rgyu skar chen po bdun: mon gre mdog ljang ut+pal bsnams: nang tshangs can gyi gdan steng bzhugs: mon gru ljang khu ut+pal bsnams: khyu mchog khri la yang dag bzhugs: khrums stod mdog ljang ut+pal bsnams: rin chen khri la yang dag bzhugs: khrums smad ljang ku ut+pal bsnams: rin chen khri yi gdan la bzhugs: nam gru mdog ljang ut+pal bsnams: nam mkha' lding gi khri la bzhugs: tha skar ljang ku ut+pal bsnams: mi yi gdan la yang dag bzhugs: bra nye mdog ljang ut+pal bsnam: 'khor lo'i khri la yang dag bzhugs: nyin zhag dus kyi dbyug 'dzin pa: rgyu skar chen po khyed rnams kyang: sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ nak+ṣa tra ya hūm̐: dza la dza la: de la de la: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sarba big+nān hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin chen po gang ba bzang: nor bu bzang dang 'brog gnas dang: ha ri ka dang pañtsi ka: shin tu drag po rdzu 'phrul can: 'gro ba'i dbugs la mnga' mdzad pa: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs: srog la phob cig mā ra ya: oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya: ma ṇi bha dra ya: ghu h+ya s+tha na: pañtsi ka:

ha ri ka: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sarba big+nān hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa: lha klu la sogs mthu bo che: ston pa'i zhal mthong bstan la dad: rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan: kha dog ldan zhing grags dang ldan: bstan pa bsrung ba'i sde brgyad rnams: rnal 'byor pa la dgra byung gis: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor: mtshon cha'i char phob srog la drongs: sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'di: 'go ba'i lha dang phrol la shog: lus dang sems su phrol la shog: dgu rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog: gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sarba big+nān hring dza: mā ra ya phaṭa:1$0000230 gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi bskul byang rdzogs so: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: i daṃ kha traṃ shu bha s+ya du ru ka smin bha wan+tu: bdag 'dra gar gyis dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris so// bkra shis so/// /
